name: Hiragana Road Fighter v0.2.1 (Adaptive Resolution & Aspect Ratio)
changelog: Auto-detection of maximum system display resolution (Steam Deck 1280x800 native, 1080p, 1440p, 4K UHD, 21:9 Ultrawide), adaptive aspect ratio preservation (letterboxing/pillarboxing) with in-game Options menu toggle (AUTO vs FULL STRETCH), and virtual mouse coordinate translation.
